title: Blues pickers near home and tracking down Joseph Phillip
summary: Few blues pickers matched Joseph Phillip and Lonnie Johnson; Miller offers to contact Phillip.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: How many blues pickers did they have out there, you say, around your neighborhood? Just get to them.

Well, they had Joseph Phillip, Roy Lonnie Johnson. Well, they had a lot more of them, but didn't compare with them, see. It was right smart to get to our players. You could see guys walking them down, the liver would get down on the shoulder all the time. You want me to get in touch with Joseph Phillip?
Yeah, that's fall. I know a guy would like to look him up, maybe take a trip over there. Yeah.
Yeah. Well, he's the type of man to find, because he can tell you a lot. He's an older fella. He's older than I am, a couple of years.
